question: In an office, a typing work can be finished by Monika in 6 hours, Anita in 8 hours and Manju in 5 hours if they work alone. How much time (in hours) will they take if they work together?
solution:
Given:

Monika can do the work in 6 hours

Anita can do the work in 8 hours

Manju can do the work in 5 hours

Formula used:

Work done = Time taken × Efficiency

Time taken ∝ 1/Efficiency

Calculation:

1st hour work by A = 1/6

2nd hour work by B = 1/8

3rd hour work by C = 1/5

Work completed in 1 hour working together:

⇒ 1/6 + 1/8 + 1/5

⇒ (20 + 15 + 24)/120 = 59/120

Time taken to complete the work

⇒ 120/59

⇒ 2(2/59)

**The entire work be finished in 2(2/59) hours.**
